entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Sacred offering-bowl vessel from Innistrad that unlocks the Sungold lock of the Celestus to stop the Eternal night.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Structure whose gold lock the Moonsilver Key opens; used to reverse the Eternal night.

entities.name: Eternal night
entities.description: The prolonged night that the Harvesttide ritual aims to stop.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane of the Key.

entities.name: Dawnheart Coven
entities.description: Coven from which the Key was taken centuries ago.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Witch who recruited Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Key and offered her soul to complete the ritual.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker who leads the search and offers her blood for the ritual.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers who help find the Key.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who later borrows the Key for temporal studies.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who found a clue and delivered the Key to Katilda.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who helps take Arlinn to the center of the Celestus.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: Cathar who joins the investigation.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City where the group began investigating.

entities.name: Worrin Betzold
entities.description: Bishop turned zombie, interrogated by Arlinn.

entities.name: Dennick Betzold
entities.description: Spirit of the bishop's son who reveals the Key went to Sorin Markov.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire who protected the Key and refused to hand it over.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel who stops Sorin's attack and is later captured by Olivia.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose statue Sorin beheaded.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather whom Olivia intended to marry.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire who interrupts the ritual and steals the Key.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Werewolf leader whose howlpack attacks the festival.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Developer of the Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Device using the Key to project Teferi's spirit into the past.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: Region where the Betzold mansion stood.

events.summary: Katilda recruits Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key; they begin in Thraben.
events.quote: Katilda recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key.

events.summary: The group learns from the zombified Worrin Betzold and the spirit of Dennick Betzold that the Key went to Sorin Markov.
events.quote: the Key was given by his great-grandfather to Sorin Markov

events.summary: Sorin refuses to hand over the Key and attacks Arlinn; Sigarda appears and stops him, and the group finds the Key in his quarters.
events.quote: In the second attack Sigarda appears

events.summary: Tovolar's howlpack attacks the festival while Kaya delivers the Key to Katilda.
events.quote: Kaya delivered the Key to Katilda

events.summary: Katilda offers her soul into the Key, but Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key.
events.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared and interrupted the ritual by taking the Key with her.

events.summary: Sorin's attack on Olivia awakens Katilda's spirit from the Key, which frees the captive Sigarda.
events.quote: used her powers to free Sigarda

events.summary: The Key and Sungold Lock are joined; the Celestus roars to life and the balance between night and day is restored.
events.quote: The balance between night and day was restored.

events.summary: Katilda lets Teferi borrow the Key, which becomes a component of Saheeli's Temporal Anchor.
events.quote: Katilda allowed Teferi to borrow the key for his temporal studies

relations.note: Ruined the ritual and took the Key with Katilda's soul.
relations.quote: After ruining the ritual, Olivia left with the Key that contained Katilda's soul.
